basic_info.description: Beautifully updated mid-century home ideally located just blocks from Ocean Ave, City College, Balboa BART station, and Ocean Ave MUNI lines. The kitchen boasts new stainless-steel appliances and flows seamlessly into the sunlit dining area and living room. Two private bedrooms on the upper level plus a pass-through room that can be utilized as a 3rd bedroom, office, den to fit your lifestyle. The lower level offers 2 car side by side parking and a full basement area with high ceilings. The property is detached on both sides and is adjacent to the pedestrian pass Ridge Lane.
